packageRules.description: github-actions: pin SHAs and auto-merge after the 7-day quarantine. Per-manager automerge scope (P2.1, GAP-21) ensures a future manager activation (e.g. npm via a new package.json) does NOT inherit automerge.

Self-reference to local composite action pinned by SHA (CIW-1). Renovate's github-actions manager treats `owner/repo/path@sha` uniformly, so pinDigests above covers the bump path. This rule exists to document intent and to ensure the self-reference is not accidentally excluded by a future matcher.

Nix install URL: scoped automerge for the same reason as github-actions. The custom manager below extracts the version from the install_url string. matchDepNames is narrowed to 'nix' so the other custom-regex managers in this file (cachix/git-hooks.nix, NixOS/nixpkgs) do NOT inherit automerge — those have wide blast radius (flake-eval-time evaluation, lib drift, package version refresh) and must be reviewed manually.
